## 01. Product Vision & Value Proposition

CampusConnect replaces the fragmented, manual campus-event stack — WhatsApp broadcasts, paper attendance sheets, and hand-edited certificate templates — with a single accountable system of record for every event, registration, attendance scan, and credential issued on campus.

| Operational Area | Traditional Campus Operations | CampusConnect Solution |
|---|---|---|
| **Event Publishing** | Notices on boards, WhatsApp forwards, no central calendar | ✅ Centralized event catalog with live registration & capacity tracking |
| **Attendance Verification** | Paper sign-in sheets, proxy attendance, manual tallying | ✅ QR-based check-in with timestamped, tamper-resistant logs |
| **Credential Issuance** | Manually typed certificates, days of turnaround, inconsistent design | ✅ Instant ReportLab-generated PDF certificates with unique IDs |
| **Student Engagement** | No feedback loop, no visibility into participation history | ✅ Gamified performance profile — points, levels & achievement badges |
| **Administrative Support** | Staff fielding repetitive queries by phone/email | ✅ Camy AI assistant handles FAQs, guides & admin actions 24/7 |

---

## 02. System Architecture

CampusConnect is built on a production-grade, containerized stack designed for reliability, auditability, and horizontal scale across multiple campuses.

| Layer | Technology | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **API Backend** | FastAPI (Python, async) | High-performance REST endpoints, request validation & async I/O |
| **Database** | PostgreSQL | Relational system of record for events, users, attendance & payments |
| **Authentication** | OAuth2 + JWT (refresh rotation) | Stateless, role-scoped session security across Admin/Organizer/Student |
| **Credential Engine** | ReportLab PDF Engine | Dynamic, branded certificate generation with unique verification IDs |
| **AI Assistant** | Camy AI — RAG pipeline | Gemini → Groq → Native RAG fallback chain for uninterrupted assistance |
| **Deployment** | Docker Compose | Reproducible multi-service orchestration (API, DB, cache, reverse proxy) |

## 04. Deployment & Infrastructure Guide

CampusConnect ships as a fully containerized bundle. A new campus environment can be provisioned end-to-end in under 15 minutes.

```bash
# 1. Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/optimus5826/campusconnect.git
cd campusconnect

# 2. Configure environment variables
cp .env.example .env
```

```env
# .env
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://campus_admin:<password>@db:5432/campusconnect
JWT_SECRET_KEY=<generate-a-256-bit-secret>
JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRE_DAYS=7
CLOUDINARY_URL=cloudinary://<key>:<secret>@<cloud_name>
GEMINI_API_KEY=<your-gemini-key>
GROQ_API_KEY=<your-groq-key>
CAMY_AI_MODE=fallback_chain
ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://campusconnectdelta.zapto.org
```

```bash
# 3. Build and launch the full stack
docker-compose up --build -d

# 4. Run database migrations
docker-compose exec api alembic upgrade head

# 5. Verify health
curl https://campusconnectdelta.zapto.org/health
```

## 05. Role-Based Operations

Every account operates within a strictly scoped role. Permissions are enforced server-side on every request.

### 🛡️ Administrator — Full platform authority
- Approve or reject organizer applications
- Publish, edit & archive campus-wide events
- View platform-wide analytics & department participation
- Issue broadcast notifications to students
- Export attendance & registration reports

### 📝 Organizer — Event-level management
- Create & configure events (category, venue, fees, dates)
- Generate event-specific QR check-in codes
- Track live registrations & capacity
- Mark attendance & close registration windows
- Trigger certificate issuance post-event

### 🎓 Student — Participant experience
- Browse & register for campus events
- Check in via QR at event venues
- Track performance score, level & badges
- Download earned certificates instantly
- Chat with Camy AI for guidance & support

## 06. Attendance Governance & Certificate Engine

> **⚠️ Eligibility Rule**
> A certificate can only be generated for a registration marked **Attended** via a verified QR check-in scan. Registrations left as "Not Attended" are permanently ineligible — there is no manual override path for organizers, only Admin-level exception logging.

**Workflow:**

1. **Student registers for an event** — Registration is logged with a unique registration ID and timestamp.
2. **Organizer generates the event QR code** — A single-use, event-scoped QR is generated for on-site check-in.
3. **Student scans QR at the venue** — Attendance status flips to "Attended" with a server-verified timestamp.
4. **Event is marked Completed** — Organizer closes the event once the schedule concludes.
5. **Certificate engine evaluates eligibility** — ReportLab renders a certificate only for attendees with verified check-ins.
6. **Student downloads the PDF credential** — Each certificate carries a unique Certificate ID for independent verification.

| Certificate Type | Award Criteria | Points Awarded |
|---|---|---|
| **Participation** | Verified attendance at any completed event | +50 pts / cert |
| **Merit / Winner** | Top-performing result in a competitive event | +100 pts / cert |
| **Excellence Award** | Outstanding, organizer-nominated contribution | +150 pts / cert |

## 07. Camy AI Assistant Blueprint

Camy is CampusConnect's embedded assistant — available to every role, in-context, with a resilient multi-model backbone so the assistant never goes fully offline.

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| 🎙️ **Multilingual Voice** | Real-time text-to-speech responses with live "speaking" waveform feedback and mid-response interrupt controls. |
| ⚡ **Autonomous Actions** | Quick-action chips let admins trigger workflows directly — e.g. "Approve Pending Organizers" — without leaving the chat. |
| 📚 **Step-by-Step Guides** | Generates numbered, platform-specific walkthroughs (e.g. accessing analytics) tailored to the requester's role. |
| 🛡️ **Security Guardrails** | Refuses prompt-injection attempts and enforces role-scoped data access on every generated answer. |

**AI Model Fallback Chain:**

`Gemini (Primary — high-context reasoning & voice synthesis)` → `Groq (Secondary — low-latency inference on rate-limit/timeout)` → `Native RAG (Tertiary — local retrieval-only mode, always available)`

---

## 08. VAPT Security & Compliance

CampusConnect undergoes structured Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing against the FastAPI/PostgreSQL stack ahead of every release.

| Control | Detail |
|---|---|
| 🛡️ **SQL Injection Shield** | Parameterized ORM queries; no raw string interpolation on any endpoint. |
| 🤖 **Prompt Injection Protection** | Camy AI sanitizes and isolates user input from system instructions. |
| 🔑 **RBAC Authorization** | Every route enforces role checks server-side, independent of UI state. |
| 🔒 **Cryptographic Auth** | JWT access + refresh token rotation with short-lived signing keys. |
| 🛡️ **XSS Sanitization** | All user-submitted content is escaped/sanitized before render or storage. |
| 📄 **Tamper-Proof Credentials** | Each certificate PDF embeds a unique, independently verifiable ID. |

## 09. Executive Pitch & Commercialization

### Why CampusConnect Wins
A single system that turns fragmented, manual campus-event administration into an auditable, self-service, AI-assisted operation — deployable to any institution in days, not months.

1. **Zero Paper Trail** — Every registration, scan and certificate is logged and verifiable.
2. **Instant Credentialing** — Certificates generate in seconds, not the days manual processes take.
3. **AI-Reduced Support Load** — Camy AI absorbs repetitive queries, freeing staff for higher-value work.
4. **Institution-Ready Deployment** — Docker Compose packaging means any campus IT team can self-host.

**Pricing:**

| Model | Price | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Annual License (SaaS) | ₹50K – ₹1.5L / yr | Subscription per institution, includes updates & support |
| **One-Time License (IP Buyout)** ⭐ | ₹2L – ₹5L | Full IP buyout — institution owns and self-hosts the codebase |
| Per-Certificate | ₹5 – ₹10 / cert | Usage-based pricing for pay-as-you-go deployments |
